sidecar.what_this_is: A derived index, not evidence. runs.ndjson stores no stratum and no timezone; this file records the collection machine's UTC offset, how it was established, and the block-to-stratum map that follows from it. runs.ndjson is unmodified and must stay so.

offset_established_by.method: collect.py stamps every log line with a naive datetime.now(); each 'block finished' line follows that block's last record, whose epoch time is in the NDJSON. Reading the stamp as UTC and subtracting the record's finished_at_unix gives offset + write-lag. The offset is the unique quarter-hour value leaving every lag in [0, 120) seconds.

sidecar.assignment_rule: stratum = the local-time hour bucket of the earliest started_at_unix among the block's records, which is exactly what collect.census() did when it decided the collection was finished.

absent.peak_in_flight_probes: not recorded by the harness on any run
absent.energy_per_scan: powermetrics is not in the schema; the driver requires AC power, which is the opposite of the on-battery, screen-off condition section 4 specifies
absent.wifi_airtime_utilisation: 'not_applicable' on all 1,578 admissible runs — bridge100 is not a Wi-Fi interface
absent.H4_naming_fractions: parse carries no naming fields; the fraction of hosts named, the fraction given a model and the fraction of randomised-MAC hosts named are in the artifact at stdout_path and not in the NDJSON

untestable.P1 (advantage scales with RTT dispersion: the testbed holds one dispersion, 500x (1 ms to 500 ms target RTT), identical at all seven apparatus commits. Nothing in this collection varies it, so the central mechanism claim is not tested here.
untestable.C8 (correlated loss): nine of ten responders carry loss_percent 0.0 and the tenth carries a flat 15%; no burst process was imposed and the capture's burstiness was never estimated, so the arm where H5 was predicted to fail hardest is not sampled.
untestable.P7 / C7 (the cost form): the record carries probes_sent but neither the concurrency c nor the retransmission interval r nor the declaration budget t, so the wave form cannot be fitted from the NDJSON.
untestable.P4 (Little's Law on peak in-flight probe: peak in-flight probes is not recorded.
untestable.P5 (marginal recall of attempt three, Wi: per-attempt outcomes are not recorded and the segment has no Wi-Fi.

exploratory_amendments.what: Kruskal-Wallis across the four strata, per condition, warm arm
exploratory_amendments.why: The design stratifies by time of day and the plan never says how to check whether the strata differ. Reporting four medians and leaving the reader to compare them by eye is worse than running the test and labelling it.
exploratory_amendments.status: exploratory; not in the family; no hypothesis reads it

exploratory_amendments.what: Gaussian kernel density on log10 wall clock, to describe the shape of each condition's distribution before its median is reported
exploratory_amendments.why: A median over a bimodal sample describes nothing and the plan does not ask whether the samples are unimodal. The density is reported, never used to decide anything.

exploratory_amendments.what: Unpaired bootstrap intervals on recall differences in the cold arm
exploratory_amendments.why: PROTOCOL.md section 7 pairs per-host outcomes within a block. One flush per block makes exactly one run per block cold, so no two conditions are ever cold in the same block and the paired test has nothing to pair. The unpaired interval is reported in its place and labelled.
exploratory_amendments.status: exploratory; the pre-declared McNemar is reported unrunnable rather than replaced

exploratory_amendments.what: netsanity's adaptive default against its own fixed-retransmit ablation, on wall clock and recall
exploratory_amendments.why: The condition matrix contains the comparison and no hypothesis asks for it. THEORY.md's contribution is per-host adaptive retransmission timing, and the ablation that removes the adaptation while keeping the split is the only thing in the study that prices it.
exploratory_amendments.status: exploratory; reported as a result, not as a hypothesis test

exploratory_amendments.what: Jaccard set stability between consecutive blocks of a condition
exploratory_amendments.why: PROTOCOL.md section 4 names run-to-run set stability as a secondary metric and section 7 names no test for it. The number is reported without one.
exploratory_amendments.status: secondary metric, reported; no test attached
